name: @stacklok/mecatl-sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for the mecatl agentic coding harness

scripts.build: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.api:check: api-extractor run --config api-extractor.json && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.node.json
scripts.api:update: api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.node.json
